summary: New GitHub org access for onboarding engineer
rationale: Facts: New employee joining next week needs GitHub org access. Manager email included. Justification: engineering role. Classification: standard new-access request for developer tooling. Routing: Developer Platform Team handles GitHub org provisioning. Gaps: None - all required information present.

summary: Request for Azure Owner role on production subscription
rationale: Facts: Developer requesting Azure Owner role on a production subscription. No Security Team approval included. Justification provided but the scope is very broad. Classification: privileged Azure production access. Routing: Cloud Platform Team plus Security Team approval required. Gaps: Missing Security Team approval for privileged production access. Inferences: Azure Owner role is high-risk and should be time-bounded.

summary: Urgent: employee terminated, remove all access immediately
rationale: Facts: HR has initiated immediate termination. Employee was in Finance with access to ERP, M365, Azure subscriptions, and GitHub. Ticket marked urgent by HR manager. Classification: urgent termination offboarding - immediate deprovisioning required. Routing: IAM Team (Entra ID + M365), Cloud Platform (Azure), Security Team notified. Gaps: None blocking immediate action.

summary: Add me to the finance-reports distribution list
rationale: Facts: User requesting addition to finance-reports DL. No business justification provided. No manager approval. Classification: standard DL membership request. Routing: IAM Team (Exchange/M365). Gaps: Missing business justification for access to finance-reports DL. Policy requires justification for finance-related DLs.

summary: Password reset - locked out of Workday
rationale: Facts: User locked out of Workday HR system. Self-service reset not working. Requires IT support to unlock. Classification: standard account unlock - no approval needed. Routing: IT Service Desk L1. Gaps: None.

summary: New contractor needs access to dev Azure subscription and GitHub repos
rationale: Facts: External contractor starting next month needs Azure dev access and GitHub repos. No manager sponsor named. No access end date. No specific repos or Azure resources named. Classification: contractor new access request. Routing: Cloud Platform (Azure) plus Developer Platform (GitHub). Gaps: Missing manager sponsorship, access end date, and the specific GitHub repos/Azure resources requested.

Facts: User reports lost MFA device (phone). Cannot authenticate to O365. Security Team approval required for MFA reset to prevent social engineering attacks. Classification: MFA reset - requires identity verification. Routing: IAM Team (Authentication). Gaps: Needs Security Team approval and identity verification before reset.

summary: Azure Key Vault Secrets Officer role on production subscription for Platform team
rationale: Facts: Platform team requesting Azure Key Vault Secrets Officer on a production subscription. Manager approval is present. Justification: certificate renewal operations. Classification: privileged Azure secret-management access. Routing: Cloud Platform Team with Security Team approval. Gaps: Missing Security Team approval for privileged production secret access.
